hunks.baseline: What awaited us when we arrived at full speed was a scene so horrific it was almost impossible to look at.
hunks.sol: What awaited us when we arrived at full speed was a scene so horrific I could barely look at it.

hunks.baseline: Corpses, pools of blood, arms and legs with no owners…
hunks.sol: Corpses. Pools of blood. Ownerless arms and legs…

hunks.baseline: If the Shaolin Temple I had seen with my own eyes a year ago had been a beautiful painting of a utopian paradise, then what lay before me now was a painting of hell.
hunks.sol: A year ago, Shaolin Temple had looked like a beautiful painting of paradise. Now, a vision of hell stretched before me.

hunks.baseline: They had clearly been killing civilians and Murim warriors alike, indiscriminately.
hunks.sol: They had clearly slaughtered everyone in their path, civilian and martial artist alike.
